route_note: Take a MARC Penn Line train or bus to New Carrollton, then a local bus to Annapolis, or drive; no direct train reaches downtown Annapolis.
tour_query: Annapolis day trip from Washington DC

route_note: Take the MARC Brunswick Line to Harpers Ferry station (weekday service) or an Amtrak Capitol Limited train; the station is a short walk from the historic lower town.
tour_query: Harpers Ferry day trip from Washington DC

route_note: Take a VRE Fredericksburg Line train or Amtrak from Union Station directly to Fredericksburg station, then walk or take a short local bus to the historic district.
tour_query: Fredericksburg day trip from Washington DC

route_note: Take a MARC Penn Line train or Amtrak from Union Station to Baltimore Penn Station, then walk or use the free Charm City Circulator to the Inner Harbor.
tour_query: Baltimore day trip from Washington DC

route_note: Take the Metro Yellow or Blue Line directly to King Street-Old Town station, then walk a few blocks to the waterfront historic district.
tour_query: Alexandria Old Town day trip from Washington DC
